articles.title: New study defines rare TCF7L2-related neurodevelopmental disorder
articles.description: Researchers have completed the largest study to date of TCF7L2-related neurodevelopmental disorder (TRND), a rare genetic condition caused by changes in the TCF7L2 gene, which plays an important role in brain development.
